description: This file defines the main React component 'MindmapClient' for the caree navigator app, responsible for displaying and managing an interactive mind map, fetching data from APIs, handling user interactions, view state persistence, and rendering UI elements such as filters, debug panel, and role details.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility to constrain a number within a min and max range.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns default filter settings for the mind map view.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Returns default view state including pan, zoom, filters, and selection.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Sanitizes and applies default values to a given view state object.

methods.name: safeErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message from any error object.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a stable user key, using personaId or anonymous ID stored locally.

methods.name: computeEmptyStateReason
methods.description: Determines the reason and message to display when the mind map cannot be rendered.

methods.name: DebugRow
methods.description: React component to display a label-value pair for debugging information.
